name: EOG Resources
description: EOG is one of the largest US independent oil and gas producers: it drills and sells crude oil, natural gas liquids and natural gas, with no refining or retail. It reports a single business, with production of 1.23 million oil-equivalent barrels a day in 2025 (up 16% from 2024), almost all in the US (Delaware Basin, Eagle Ford, Bakken, Utica and Powder River) plus Trinidad and, since 2025, Bahrain. Revenue comes overwhelmingly from selling its own oil (55 percent of 2025 revenue), gas liquids and gas at market prices, plus a pass-through marketing business (22 percent of revenue) that buys and resells third-party production at almost no profit. It bought Encino Acquisition Partners (Utica gas) on August 1, 2025 for 5.7 billion dollars including debt. Earnings track commodity prices: net income was 4,980 million dollars in 2025 (6,403 million in 2024) and 4,704 million dollars in the first half of 2026 (2,808 million a year earlier) as NYMEX oil averaged 82.57 dollars a barrel (up 22%).

businessLines.name: Crude oil and condensate
businessLines.shareBasis: 12,501 of 22,632 million total operating revenues and other
businessLines.how: Sold at market-linked prices to refiners; two refining-industry purchasers each took more than 10% of total revenue in 2025. Profit is price minus the cost of drilling and lifting.
businessLines.description: Oil and condensate produced in US shale basins, Trinidad and (from 2025) Bahrain and the UAE.

businessLines.name: Natural gas liquids
businessLines.how: Sold at market-linked prices to petrochemical and fuel buyers.
businessLines.description: Ethane, propane and other liquids extracted from the gas stream.

businessLines.name: Natural gas
businessLines.how: Sold mostly at spot prices at the point of sale, transported by pipeline across the US and to the Dawn Hub in Ontario.
businessLines.description: Dry gas from the Delaware Basin, Eagle Ford, Trinidad and the Utica (expanded by Encino).

revenue.note: 2024: 1,551 (realized US price 2.94 dollars per Mcf vs 1.99)

businessLines.revenueNote: 2024: 1,551 (realized US price 2.94 dollars per Mcf vs 1.99)

businessLines.name: Gathering, processing and marketing
businessLines.how: Resells purchased barrels and molecules for a small margin: 2025 revenue 4,914 million against marketing costs of 4,795 million, so it adds revenue but almost no profit.
businessLines.description: Buys crude oil and gas from third parties to resell, plus gathering and processing services.
